diagnosis: Streaming whole-archive hashing and direct file-backed ZIP reading passed all security and host tests but did not lower the integrated peak. Active-host identity verification still calls the full package loader, which deserializes a second complete tensor mapping while the activated mapping is resident. The 828616704-byte peak is consistent with activation storage plus a second safe-tensor decode and transient payload storage.
decision: Preserve this failed repair. Keep streaming archive reads, and make active-host verify cryptographic and allocation-bounded: stream the archive hash, canonical manifest, tensor-payload hash, package content hash, and signature without deserializing tensors. Initial install/activation must continue to fully deserialize and validate safe tensors. Add a test that fails if active verify invokes safe-tensor deserialization, then bind and rerun the unchanged CPU/CUDA screen.
claim_boundary: Negative evidence for streaming archive reads alone. It authorizes only a no-deserialization active-verification repair, not altered artifacts, gates, or quality claims.
